unit.title: NAND Component Engineering: Specification, Composition, and Verification
unit.learner_profile: A strong algorithms student building practical software-engineering habits
unit.scope: Implement a small, platform-neutral Boolean component library from one trusted NAND primitive and produce deterministic verification and engineering evidence.
learning_objectives: Translate finite Boolean behavior into explicit component contracts.
Build derived components through constrained composition and clear interfaces.
Use exhaustive deterministic tests as evidence over a finite input domain.
Make implementation constraints, assumptions, commands, and verification results reviewable by another engineer.
included_components: NOT, AND, OR, and two-input multiplexer components
Exhaustive tests, a reproducible test command, a design note, and written comprehension responses
excluded_scope: Claims of completing an official Nand2Tetris project or week
Sequential logic, registers, memory, CPU, and machine language
Virtual machine, compiler, operating system, GUI, and Tetris work

required_evidence: A submission containing the specified source, tests, documentation, and comprehension responses
A captured passing run from the documented one-command test procedure
Independent inspection of the NAND-only composition constraint
completion_policy.completion_effect: Passing may mark kickoff_nand_component_engineering_v1 complete; it must not change the course to complete or imply completion of an official course unit.
